chapter: Wider talk: bands, places and players
title: Playing Gulfport but not Biloxi
summary: The Six Nola Jazz Band played a week at Ellis Stratakos's family restaurant in Gulfport.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah. So, that's just the way it worked out. And, uh, let me get back to, did you ever play much around Biloxi?
Uh, no. Uh, we, we, uh, we didn't play at Biloxi, but when we had the Six Nola Jazz Band, we played, you see, Ellis Stratica's father had a candy store in, in, uh, what's that town?

Gulfport. Yeah. Right. So, he opened, uh, opened a restaurant. Mm-hmm. And, and they had a bandstand built up there, so we, uh, we played there for a week. And we, uh, and, uh, we, we played at this, uh, Splendid, Splendid, uh, Cafe, that's what they call it.

And we played there for a week with the band. And, uh, well, as far as Biloxi, I don't, I don't remember ever, ever, ever playing at, Yeah. In the White House or any of those places. Mm-hmm. I don't remember.
